# UatuCode

UatuCode is a local documentation workbench and self-hostable Hub with a public HTTP and streaming API contract.

Current edge artifacts:
- Metadata: https://tjakobsson.github.io/uatu/api/edge/contract.json
- Agent guide: https://tjakobsson.github.io/uatu/api/edge/agent.md
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://tjakobsson.github.io/uatu/api/edge/openapi.yaml
- Streaming contract: https://tjakobsson.github.io/uatu/api/edge/streaming.yaml
- API changelog: https://tjakobsson.github.io/uatu/api/edge/CHANGELOG.md

Release channels (populated from the first tagged release onward; prefer these for production clients):
- Latest released contract: https://tjakobsson.github.io/uatu/api/latest/
- Immutable revision snapshots: https://tjakobsson.github.io/uatu/api/revisions/hub-N_workspace-M_vX.Y.Z/

Human documentation:
- Product and guides: https://tjakobsson.github.io/uatu/
- Searchable API reference: https://tjakobsson.github.io/uatu/docs/api/

OpenAPI governs HTTP wire details. The streaming contract governs SSE, NDJSON, and WebSocket behavior. Metadata and changelog govern revision selection and migration.
